title: Richard Grey, Robin S, Dead As Disko - Show Me Love Feat. Robin S (2021 Disco Rework)

lines.l: Oh, it's got me in its spell
A feeling that I know so well
Well, let me tell you, let me tell you what you do, what you do, what you do to me, and all I want to say is thank you, baby.
Can you feel me, feel me
I'm tired of being caught up in those one line that stands
You've got to show me love
Oh, I need you to show me
Cross your ride all the time
